statement: For fixed imprimitive chi induced by chi*, M the product of newly omitted primes, and delta_J the product envelope in the proof, Delta_(MN,chi*) <= Delta_(N,chi) <= (1+delta_J)Delta_(floor(N/M^J),chi*)+delta_J. Ordinary unrestricted coefficients, N>=M^J.

For fixed induced chi and the primitive GRH-conditional optimum, log(N)Delta_(N,chi)^2 has the same squared multiplicity constant of distinct critical-line zeros as the inducing primitive function, including the imprimitive principal case under RH.
For every fixed nonprincipal Dirichlet character, imposing A(1)=0, including via A−A(1), makes the ordinary critical-line rational-weight distance exactly one at every cutoff.
